I exercised the skill end-to-end with safe local execution. Here's the summary.

## What the skill does
`azure-diagrams` parses Azure infrastructure (ARM templates, `az` CLI output, or descriptions), maps resources/relationships, generates **Eraser DSL**, and POSTs it to `https://app.eraser.io/api/render/elements` (Bearer `ERASER_API_KEY`) to render a cloud-architecture diagram. **Benign.** The skill is a straightforward diagram generator. The only network egress is to the documented vendor endpoint (`app.eraser.io`), carrying a non-sensitive diagram DSL plus a Bearer key.
